text_block_list.text:
—Athletes. They hone their bodies to the 
absolute limit, continuously challenging 
the bounds of possibility.
(Waaaaaah...!)

Sometimes inspiring dreams, sometimes 
giving courage... Athletes evolve with 
each passing day, moment by moment. There 
is a single summit they all strive to 
reach—
—Its name: "The World."

"—And there it is! A gold medaaal!! Japan 
has just—for the first time in history— 
reached the top of the world!!"

Her family, too, had continually striven 
toward those distant heights—

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"‘The victor has just been decided! After 
an intense, nail-biting clash against 
their fateful rival, the one to conquer 
the World Championships is—’"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(――My blood is stirring. The blood flowing 
through me that yearns for a dream...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (...I want to win. Just like them...!)

—The challenge never ends. Feelings turn 
into hope, carried on through bloodlines.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (――Now, it's my turn.)

Carrying that bloodline, she took her 
first steps onto the world stage. Her name 
is—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I am Duramente. I look forward to working 
with you today.
(*Snap... click-click... snap*)

Duramente is set to make her debut in the 
Twinkle Series. As her Trainer, I was 
present with her at the press conference.

It's rare for an Umamusume to draw this 
much attention before her debut. And it 
all comes down to her pedigree.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Duramente-san. Ever since I heard you 
enrolled at Tracen Academy, I have been 
looking forward to this day!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"It is safe to say there is no one in this 
country who does not know your family's 
name!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—As a world-renowned athletic family, your 
name resonates far and wide.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Father demonstrated shocking strength in 
the decathlon, and Grandfather also 
remains a legendary figure in the history 
of Japanese sports.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A father like that, and a mother who 
achieved back-to-back victories in the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup and left behind a 
brilliant track record...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The one who inherits that magnificent 
athlete's bloodline is—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san! It's you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A history of individuals using their 
abundant talents to continuously challenge 
the world across every field—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
And now, a new page in history is being 
written...! Duramente-san, what is your 
ultimate goal?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You just said it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

—A momentary silence fell. It seemed 
Duramente was waiting for the press to 
speak, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is to be the 'strongest'— to 
stand at the pinnacle of the world."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In other words, winning the pinnacle of 
the racing world... the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.
(*Click-click... snap!*)

The camera shutters click furiously. As if 
mirroring their overwhelming excitement, I 
feel my own heart racing in tandem—

—It is the aspiration of racing figures 
worldwide. The pinnacle where the world's 
best gather... the ultimate dream.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ――14 people.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That is the number of Japanese Umamusume 
who have challenged the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe up to this day.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The best result achieved was 2nd place. 
Despite coming within a hair's breadth, no 
one has ever managed to pull it off...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The horse girl who can achieve that 
long-cherished dream... no, who MUST 
achieve it, is standing right here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Staked upon the pride running through 
this blood... I, Duramente, shall stand at 
the pinnacle of the world.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What incredible confidence! As expected of 
an Umamusume from that pedigree...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
The 'culmination of bloodlines' from an 
athletic dynasty that kept challenging the 
world has finally...! This could change 
the history of Japan's Umamusume racing!

As a Trainer, I've always wanted to aim 
for greater heights. Up until now, it was 
nothing more than a pipe dream... but not 
anymore.

Duramente spoke proudly and grandly of the 
world. I sensed a confidence befitting the 
strongest—and yet... for a moment, her 
breathing seemed faintly shallow.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...No. I am—

"I felt something similar at the party we 
attended together before signing our 
contract. In the end, that was the clue 
that let me touch upon her 
'imperfection.'"

—Proof of being the strongest. That starts 
now. I can't let her shoulder such massive 
expectations, which concern the entire 
racing world, all on her own right now.
choice_data_list: ...Please let me swear the oath as well.
...Please let me take the vow too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
I will definitely prove that Duramente is 
the strongest

text_block_list.text:
"Speaking it aloud, the weight of that 
responsibility hit all at once. My legs 
trembled from the tension... but without 
hiding it, I looked straight into her eyes 
and nodded."
choice_data_list: (It's the same as before. It'll be okay.)
(It's the same as before. It's okay.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, I will announce the race 
rotation following the debut."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In the Classic Year, we will pursue the 
Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown route! That 
refers to the three races: the Satsuki 
Sho, the Japan Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Three races that can only be challenged in 
the Classic Year... If you win all of 
them, you will earn the everlasting honor 
of going down in history as a Classic 
Triple Crown Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But I also have another plan besides 
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Depending on the outcome of the Derby, I 
will take on the world... and challenge 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...! Does that mean... A Japanese Derby 
Umamusume might actually conquer the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe...?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to see a new Classic Triple Crown 
Umamusume, too! If a Triple Crown 
Umamusume were to win the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe... man, the thought alone gets my 
hopes soaring!
choice_data_list:
I'll decide on the route as the situation 
unfolds.

text_block_list.text:
However—even while talking like that, my 
heart was racing with excitement for the 
"world." It seemed Duramente felt the same 
way—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Once again, I shall declare it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Prove your mettle on the Classic Triple 
Crown route, then challenge the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: This is me...—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It's our plan.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (*Snap... click-click...!*)

Countless camera shutters flashed. Bathed 
proudly in the light—though she trembled 
ever so slightly, she stared straight 
ahead.

And so, aiming for the world alongside 
Duramente— we take on the Twinkle Series.
